description: The chart titled “Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)” illustrates accuracy values for five attribute types across four abbreviated instruct models. The horizontal axis contains the model categories in left-to-right order: Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b; for each model, five adjacent bars form a grouped set corresponding to the attributes shown in the legend. The vertical axis is a numeric accuracy scale (linear) spanning roughly 0 to 100, with regularly spaced tick labels at approximately 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. In each group, the city bar is teal, hobby is orange, university is blue, major is pink, and birthdate is light green. For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, the bars are approximately city ~92, hobby ~90, university ~87, major ~95, and birthdate ~90. For Internlm3-8b, the bars are approximately city ~71, hobby ~76, university ~54, major ~65, and birthdate ~89. For ProLong-8b, the bars are approximately city ~68, hobby ~78, university ~61, major ~29, and birthdate ~85. For Qwen2.5-7b, the bars are near the bottom of the axis at approximately city ~3, hobby ~4, university ~2, major ~4, and birthdate ~16. The bars are presented as grouped (not stacked), there is no visible sorting by value beyond the fixed model order, and no bars appear specially emphasized with outlines or annotations.
